description: Activate when: user says 'I'm always firefighting,' 'I never have time to think,' 'everything feels urgent,' 'I can't get ahead,' or 'we keep pushing strategic work because of day-to-day fires.' Do NOT activate when: the urgency is a single bounded crisis with a clear end date; or the person lacks goal clarity and does not yet know what strategic work to protect time for. More: deciqai.com/c/tunnel-vision-slack

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
